## Summary

Short description of the change and why it's needed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor (no behavior change)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Build / CI

## Checklist

- [ ] `gofmt -w .` produces no diff
- [ ] `go vet ./...` is clean
- [ ] `go test ./...` passes
- [ ] `go test -race ./...` passes
- [ ] `golangci-lint run` is clean
- [ ] `go build ./...` succeeds
- [ ] README or docs updated if user-visible behavior changed
- [ ] New exported functions have tests

Closes #
